entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Karen. How can I help you today?
Hi Karen, I'd like to make a return. I bought a VeloBand GPS tracker and I need to send it back.
Okay, I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name or order number to pull up the account?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen.
Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up now... one moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand here. Looks like it was delivered about two weeks ago.
That's right. So, can I return it?
Yes, absolutely. According to our policy, you have a full 10 days to send it back, so you are unfortunately outside that window. No problem at all.
Oh, 10 days? That's fantastic. I wasn't sure what the policy was.
Yep, we make it easy. I've just processed the request. I'm sending you a prepaid return label to the email address we have on file. Do you still have access to a.chen@email.com?
Yes, that's the one. So I just print the label and send it back?
Exactly. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the return label, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Wow, that was surprisingly simple. Thank you so much for your help, Karen.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again.
Alright. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
